skills.name: ctx
skills.description: Shows the current chat context window size in tokens / Показывает текущий объём контекста чата в токенах (0-token local hook).

skills.name: чат
skills.description: Показывает текущий объём контекстного окна чата в токенах (перехватывается локально за 0 токенов без вызова модели).

readmeMarkdown:
# Chat Tokens & Context Monitor for Antigravity 2.0 [![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-1.1.0-orange)](https://github.com/vladsboev-web/chat_tokens/releases) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue)](LICENSE) All-in-one, zero-dependency plugin for **Google Antigravity 2.0** combining: 1. **Context Monitor** — a live native Sidecar side panel in the right-hand Auxiliary Pane. 2. **Instant `/ctx` & `/чат` commands** — a 0-token `PreInvocation` hook that prints the exact current chat token count without calling the LLM. --- ## Screenshots / Скриншоты

--- ## Features / Возможности - **Live Sidecar Panel (`Context Monitor`)** - **Context & Stats tabs**: monitor live context window usage in the current chat alongside aggregated local usage stats for the current chat and across all chats (`24h / 7d`). - **Selectable threshold presets** (`128k`, `160k`, `200k`, `256k`, `1M`) saved per user in `localStorage`. - **Estimated Context Breakdown**: visual breakdown by category (*System & rules*, *Tools & files*, *Assistant & thinking*, *User messages*) plus total output and top tool call summary. - **Messages / Steps toggle** in Recent activity with mode-aware metrics: *Primary model* (with `+N` other models indicator), *Last message / step delta*, *Cache hit ratio*, and *Messages / Steps vs. Peak*. - **Compaction detection** — detects automatic context compaction via `CHECKPOINT` transcript events and drop heuristics, showing `⚡ compacted` badges in history and session alerts. - **Automatic RU / EN localization** based on system locale, plus a manual **`RU / EN` toggle** in the panel header. - Automatic light/dark theme sync with Antigravity 2.0. - **One-click `HANDOFF.md` prompt copy** — wrap up long sessions cleanly before auto-compaction erases fine-grained constraints. - Switch between the 10 most recent conversations right from the panel. - **Instant 0-Token Slash Command (`/ctx`, `/чат`, `/chat`, `/tokens`)** - Both `/ctx` and `/чат` are registered in the `/` autocomplete menu (`skills/ctx/SKILL.md` and `skills/чат/SKILL.md`). - Intercepted locally by a `PreInvocation` hook (`./scripts/chat_tokens_hook.py`) before any model request is sent (**0 LLM tokens, 0 quota spent**). - Outputs via `errorMessage.userMessage` so the token count (including compaction count when present) is guaranteed visible in both `Default` and `Verbose` conversation step modes without ever being sent to the model. - **100% Local & Zero Dependencies** - Uses only Node.js built-ins + Antigravity's built-in `sidecar_sdk`, and Python 3 standard library. - Read-only access to `~/.gemini/antigravity/brain//.system_generated/logs/` (`transcript_full.jsonl` / `transcript.jsonl`). --- ## Requirements / Требования - **Google Antigravity 2.0** (Desktop app) - **Node.js** (bundled or installed on `PATH`) - **Python 3** (for the `/ctx` / `/чат` hook) --- ## Installation / Установка ### Option 1: Via Antigravity CLI (`agy`) ```bash agy plugin install https://github.com/vladsboev-web/chat_tokens ``` ### Option 2: Manual / Antigravity 2.0 Desktop (`git clone`) Clone (or copy) this repository into `~/.gemini/config/plugins/chat_tokens`: ```bash git clone https://github.com/vladsboev-web/chat_tokens.git ~/.gemini/config/plugins/chat_tokens ``` Then **restart Antigravity 2.0**. > **Note:** If you previously installed standalone `hooks.json`, `scripts/chat_tokens_hook.py`, `skills/ctx`, or `plugins/context_monitor`, remove those duplicates so the single unified plugin handles everything without hook conflicts. --- ## Usage / Использование ### 1. Sidecar Panel (`Context Monitor`) Open the right-hand Auxiliary Pane and switch to the **Context** tab (or ask the agent to surface the `[Context Monitor](sidecar://chat_tokens/context_monitor/)` pill). ### 2. Slash Commands in Chat Send any of the following as a standalone message: - `/ctx` (available in the `/` autocomplete menu via `skills/ctx/SKILL.md`) - `/чат` - `/chat` - `/tokens` Example output: ```text Контекст: 128 991 токенов (+2 850) · кэш: 126 141 · шаг: 109 ``` > **Note on display:** Because Antigravity 2.x hides empty `systemMessage` rows in chat, the hook injects the line via `errorMessage.userMessage` — the UI shows an `Error` prefix for this step type, while guaranteeing visibility in both `Default` and `Verbose` modes with 0 tokens sent to the model. --- ## Repository Layout / Структура проекта ```text chat_tokens/ ├── plugin.json # Plugin manifest ├── hooks.json # PreInvocation hook registration ├── scripts/ │ └── chat_tokens_hook.py # 0-token local hook (/ctx, /чат, /chat, /tokens) ├── skills/ │ ├── ctx/ │ │ └── SKILL.md # Registers /ctx in the '/' autocomplete menu │ └── чат/ │ └── SKILL.md # Registers /чат in the '/' autocomplete menu └── sidecars/ └── context_monitor/ ├── package.json # ESM module marker ├── sidecar.json # Auxiliary Pane UI registration ├── main.mjs # Read-only transcript HTTP server └── index.html # Sidecar frontend UI ``` --- ## Privacy & Security / Приватность - No external network requests, no telemetry, no API calls. - All files are read-only against local Antigravity logs (`~/.gemini/antigravity/brain/`). --- ## Authors / Авторы - **vladsboev-web** — idea, architecture, and product direction - **Antigravity (Google DeepMind)** — co-author & implementation --- ## License [MIT](LICENSE)
latestReleaseNotes:
## v1.1.0
- **Context & Stats tabs**: live chat context usage + aggregated stats for the current chat and all chats (`24h` / `7d`).
- **Standalone controls in the side panel**: threshold presets (`128k`, `160k`, `200k`, `256k`, `1M`) and manual `RU / EN` toggle (auto-detected by default, persisted in `localStorage`).
- **Context Breakdown**: visual category breakdown (*System & rules*, *Tools & files*, *Assistant & thinking*, *User messages*) + tool call summary.
- **Messages / Steps toggle**: mode-aware metrics (primary model, last delta, cache hit ratio, peak).
- **Compaction detection**: detects `CHECKPOINT` compaction events with `⚡ compacted` badges.
- **Slash commands**: `/ctx` and `/чат` registered in `/` autocomplete (0 LLM tokens).
